title: Thick And Chewy S'mores Cookies Recipe

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instructionText: Add [unsalted butter] , [granulated sugar] , and [light brown sugar] to a [bowl] and whisk on mediu[Ingredient] m high speed for [2-3 minutes] until the mixture turns fluffy and light in color. Keep scraping the bowl along the way.[Cookware] [Black pepper] [granulated sugar]

tokens.text: until the mixture turns fluffy and light in color. Keep scraping the bowl along the way.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instructionText: Add large egg , egg yolk , and vanilla. Whisk for another 1 minute until a creamy mixture forms.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instructionText: Add crushed graham crackers and whisk until just combined.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instructionText: Now sift [all purpose flour] , [baking powder] , [baking soda] , and [salt] in a separate bowl and mix to combine. Add the dry ingredients to the cookie dough in 2 additions, and use a rubber spatula to gently fold until the flour is almost mixed into the dough.[Coffee diping!]

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instructionText: Add dark chocolate chips and mini marshmallows , and continue folding until no more streaks of flour remain and the add-ins are evenly dispersed. Don't overmix.

tokens.text: , and continue folding until no more streaks of flour remain and the add-ins are evenly dispersed. Don't overmix.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instructionText: The cookie dough should be soft and easy to work with. If it feels too sticky, refrigerate it for 10-15 minutes until it becomes easier to shape with your hands.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instructionText: Divide the cookie dough into 5 portions, each should be about 5.5oz in weight. Working one piece at a time, gently shape into a ball, then lightly flatten so they form a 2.5-3" disc. Repeat with all portions.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instructionText: Place the cookie dough balls on a plate/tray and refrigerate overnight (minimum 6 hours, overnight recommended).

steps.instructionText: When you're ready to bake after chilling, pre-heat the oven to 375F (conventional / no fan) and line a large light colored baking sheet with parchment paper.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instructionText: Place the chilled cookie dough balls on the baking sheet, keeping at least 3" between each.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instructionText: Transfer to the oven and bake at 375F for 8 minutes, then drop the temperature to 350F and bake for another 7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instructionText: Remove the tray from the oven, and use the back of a measuring spoon to press down the middles of the cookies and create a pocket/indent. Place giant marshmallows into the pocket on each cookie, and quickly return the cookie tray to the oven. Try to do this step as quickly as you can so the cookies remain hot.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instructionText: Bake for another 2-4 minutes until the cookies are golden, look set on the edges but still soft in the middle, and the marshmallows on top have started to get a light golden color on them.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.instructionText: Remove the cookies from the oven, and let them cool at room temperature for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.instructionText: In the meanwhile, melt dark chocolate in the microwave in 20 seconds increments, stirring in between. Transfer it to a piping bag and snip a small hole at the tip.

steps.title: Step 16
steps.instructionText: Once the cookies have rested, take a blowtorch and quickly torch the marshmallows so they become warm and toasted. Then drizzle the chocolate on top of the cookies generously.
